name: 60010 · Barrington, IL
findings: ZIP 60010 (Barrington) has 266 nonprofit organizations. 106 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 79 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60010 (Barrington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60010 (Barrington) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
